description: Combine many photos into a single contact-sheet grid with adjustable columns.

faqs.a: Upload any number of images; they are arranged into a neat grid with labels.
faqs.q: How does the contact sheet work?

faqs.a: 2 to 5 columns — the tool picks a layout that fits all your images.
faqs.q: How many columns can I choose?

howto: Drop multiple images into the tool.
Click Download PNG to save the contact sheet.
title: Image Contact Sheet
